title: pm-eng-1on1-prep-priya-shah-daniel-rivera
content:
Purpose: quick sync with Dan (eng lead, serving/runtime) before Thursday exec review. Focus on short-term delivery (next 2 sprints) for Hosted API latency SLOs, console rollout for rollout policies, Dedicated capacity pricing commit, and the Private on-prem pilot schedule.

Agenda:
- Quick status (2 min): how the team is feeling, any immediate blockers.
- API latency SLOs (10 min): perf work, kernel selection, A/B with quantized variants, metrics we can show in exec slides.
- Console features (10 min): rollout UI for canary/A-B, trace linking, rollout rollback UX polish.
- Dedicated (8 min): pricing commit for Q2 customers, autoscaling burst behavior, capacity forecasting spreadsheet review.
- Private/on-prem pilot (8 min): deployment packaging, KMS/HSM integration status, customer-ready docs and install checklist.
- Risks & escalations (5 min): capacity constraints, reg compliance items, hiring gaps.
- Action items and owners (2 min).

Notes + prep items (notes to self):
- API latency: ask Dan for latest p50/p95 numbers separated by model family + token length. Need a slide that shows before/after of kernel perf for llama-3-small quantized swap (we promised a 20% p95 improvement).
- Check with infra on the kernel rollout plan: what windows can we do for the production switch? Any DB migrations for model catalog?
- For console rollouts: confirm whether rollout config UI supports auto-fallback to cheaper model variant. If not, note as follow-up.
- Dedicated pricing: finance needs a deterministic cost per vGPU-day and suggested commit tiers. Pull the capacity model spreadsheet and bring to the 1:1.
- Private pilot: confirm list of pilot customers (currently ACME Bank + HealthCo), target install week, and whether legal has approved the pilot contract. Ask Dan to escalate to solutions-eng if we need more hands.
- Risks: hiring for two infra SRE roles delayed; this might impact on-call coverage for rollout weeks.

Unresolved questions to raise:
- Do we have a safe automatic fallback for incompatible quantized kernels? (If not, we risk more manual rollbacks.)
- Is the autoscaler for Dedicated tested under spike loads used by Customer X? Need to request a soak test.
- What is the expected customer-visible downtime window for kernel/model transitions?

Pre-read to attach to the 1:1:
- Link to perf dashboards (internal): CONFLUENCE-API-SLOS
- Draft slide deck for exec review (attach latest on Google Slides)
- Capacity forecast spreadsheet: https://github.com/redwood-inference/finance/capacity-q2 (will link in Slack)

Tone notes to self: be direct about blockers; offer to remove product scope if engineering bandwidth is constrained. Keep the ask specific: one decision or commitment per agenda item.

Follow-up template I'll use after the 1:1:
- TL;DR summary + decisions made (one-paragraph).
- Action items table with owner and due date.
- Ask for confirmation on dates and owners within 24 hours.
action_items: Dan: Share p50/p95 by model family + token length by 2025-02-22
Dan + Infra: Confirm kernel rollout maintenance window by 2025-02-24
Priya: Update exec slides with perf delta and capacity ask by 2025-02-21
Dan: Schedule Dedicated autoscaler soak test with SRE and link results by 2025-03-03
Solutions-Eng: Stand up Private pilot runbook and install checklist for ACME Bank by 2025-03-10
Finance: Provide cost per vGPU-day and suggested commit tiers (cc Priya) by 2025-02-28
